# pageTemplate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Builds a page template from elements instead of a function.

For page *n* (1-based) the template returns the first present of `firstPage` (page 1 only), then `odd` or `even` by the parity of *n*, then `default`; when none applies it returns nothing for that page. At least one member is required.

The same element instance is returned on every page it applies to, so it must be reusable across pages. `{{CurrentPage}}` and `{{TotalPages}}` in text let one element show a different number on each.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
pageTemplate(elements: PageTemplateElements): PageTemplate
```
